board.label: Choose the song
board.title: Into which song's mood board?
board.moveText: The file is moved into the mood board's folder (a sound a project uses as a sample is copied there, never moved). Ctrl+Z undoes it.
board.linkText: The file stays where it is: it simply shows on the mood board. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
board.moveCheck: Move the file into the mood board's folder

move.label: Move {name}
move.title: Move "{name}"
move.intro: The whole folder moves (samples included). Nothing is overwritten: if the name is taken, it becomes "Name (2)". The song keeps its stage, notes and mood board. Ctrl+Z puts it back.

impossible.one: Not possible: {n} sample would be lost ({list}).
impossible.other: Not possible: {n} samples would be lost ({list}).

reorg.title: Reorganise the folders
reorg.intro: Puts each song folder under its artist, in your main folder. An artist folder that already exists is reused ("- ODA KEEL" for Oda Keel). A folder where a project would lose a sample stays in place. Ctrl+Z puts everything back.

left.one: {n} left out (no artist, or several artists)
left.other: {n} left out (no artist, or several artists)

reorg.empty: Everything is already sorted this way.
